notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three: no build date, staffing record, or removal date was found. A Forest Fire Lookout Association Facebook post, seen only as a search snippet, describes a 1963 Bald Eagle lookout on Plumas NF with tripod legs and a crank cab; the page returned only a login wall to fetch_text, so nothing from it is used or quoted. It is the best lead for build and staffing history. The Forest Lookouts page calls the site Bald Eagle Butte while FFLA calls it Bald Eagle Mountain; the two names are treated as one site on the basis of the matching Plumas County location, which should be confirmed. The 1974 notice's 'the dam' is not named. No photo found.
